001: I need to travel to São Paulo next week for an important meeting.
That's great! Do you already know how you're going to get around the city?
Not yet. I think I'm going to need a rental car or a taxi.
Maybe it's better to use a ride-hailing app, it's more practical.
That's true, but I need to confirm if the hotel is close to the client's office.
If you want, I can check the location for you.
002: Have you already booked the hotel for the business trip?
Not yet, I was thinking about staying near the convention center.
Good idea, that way you save time on commuting.
Do you know any good hotel in that area?
I know one that the company usually uses, it has a good cost-benefit.
Great! Can you give me the contact so I can make the reservation?
003: I'm organizing the documentation for tomorrow's trip.
Have you already checked if your passport is within the validity period?
Yes, I checked yesterday. I also confirmed the flight reservation.
And travel insurance, have you already gotten it?
Not yet, I need to do that this afternoon.
Don't forget to bring a printed copy of the important documents.
004: What do you usually take in your carry-on bag on business trips?
I usually take my laptop, the chargers, and a change of clothes.
That makes sense, in case there's any delay with the checked luggage.
Exactly. I also take the medications I use regularly.
Do you take any printed presentation materials?
It depends. If it's a formal meeting, I take a few copies.
005: I need to prepare the presentation for the meeting with the investors.
Do you already have the updated data from the last quarter?
I do, but I need to organize it in a more visual format.
If you need help with the charts, I can take a look.
Thanks! Maybe we can review it together tomorrow morning.
Sounds good. I'll set aside some time in my schedule for that.
006: Have you thought about how you're going to communicate with the office during the trip?
I plan to use my cell phone and the company's messaging app.
And what if there's a problem with the internet connection?
In that case, I can use the hotel phone or look for a coworking space.
Good solution. It's always good to have a backup plan.
Definitely. I'm also going to save the main contacts on my phone.
007: The meeting with the client was moved up to nine in the morning.
Wow, then you're going to need to leave the hotel really early.
Yes, I plan to leave around seven thirty to avoid the traffic.
Do you already know the best route to their office?
The hotel staff suggested a route, but I'm going to confirm it on the map.
If you want, I can check the traffic conditions for you.
008: I'm thinking about extending the trip by one day to visit a supplier.
Interesting! That could be a good opportunity to strengthen the partnership.
Yeah, but I need to see if I can reschedule the flight without paying a fee.
Have you already contacted the travel agency?
Not yet, I'm going to call them in a little while.
Good luck! I hope you can get that sorted out without any complications.
009: Have you already set the budget for the trip expenses?
Not yet, I need to estimate the costs for food and transportation.
Remember to keep all the receipts for the reimbursement.
Yes, I'm going to save everything in the expense management app.
Great. That way it's easier to report to the finance department.
True. I'm going to do that as soon as I get to the hotel.
010: Are you excited about the business trip next week?
I am, but also a little nervous about the presentation to the board.
Don't worry, you're well prepared and you know the subject well.
Thanks for the support. Still, I want to review the numbers one more time.
If you want, we can do a practice run of the presentation this afternoon.
That would be great! I'll take the opportunity to clear up some questions with you.
